detail.longDescription: Just a side-quest here: why on earth do I have to create all that shit on # kubernetes ? 1. I don't have to. This is a bunch of computers on my home network. Who cares? I do it because I want to. 2. kubernetes has the concept of namespaces to logically separate workloads from each other, but it is not a real boundary. Pods can reach any other pod by default. If you want to make it 'secure', you first need to create a deny policy, and add what you want to allow in next policies.
